rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with one dominant prismatic/bent-bar idea and a readable hierarchy, and it responds to the parcel better than a generic box. The silhouette is fairly resolved, but the visible void/court logic is weak: the blue access edge is not answered by a clearly public threshold, undercut, or entry seam. The mass reads more as a compact object than as a neighborhood living building with an active ground condition, so program_fit_hard_pass fails. The form is not visibly colliding across views and is consistent in all four views, so it remains salvageable. The main improvement needed is to carve a stronger public void or notch aligned to the verified frontage and preserve the dominant bent mass rather than fragmenting it.
